```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| label: tbl-waste-opportunity-cost
#| tbl-cap: "Opportunity cost of wasteful U.S. government spending relative to the disease eradication program. The program costs ~$784B total ($21.8B/yr over ~36 years) to avert ~565B DALYs. Each waste category is compared against that annual funding requirement."
from IPython.display import Markdown
import numpy as np

from dih_models.dfda_trial_economics import (
    compute_at_funding_level, get_ceiling_dalys,
)

# ── Compute eradication program cost via shared library ─────────────────
proposed = compute_at_funding_level()  # at proposed treaty funding
total_program_cost = proposed["total_cost"]
proposed_funding = proposed["funding"]
proposed_clearance = proposed["clearance_years"]
proposed_dalys = proposed["dalys_averted"]
ceiling_dalys = get_ceiling_dalys()

# ── Waste categories (from parameters.py) ────────────────────────────────
categories = [
    ("Housing & Zoning Restrictions", float(US_GOV_WASTE_HOUSING_ZONING)),
    ("Healthcare Inefficiency", float(US_GOV_WASTE_HEALTHCARE_INEFFICIENCY)),
    ("Tax Compliance Burden", float(US_GOV_WASTE_TAX_COMPLIANCE)),
    ("Military Overspend", float(US_GOV_WASTE_MILITARY_OVERSPEND)),
    ("Tariffs (GDP Loss)", float(US_GOV_WASTE_TARIFFS)),
    ("Drug War", float(US_GOV_WASTE_DRUG_WAR)),
    ("Fossil Fuel Subsidies", float(US_GOV_WASTE_FOSSIL_FUEL_SUBSIDIES)),
    ("Agricultural Subsidies", float(US_GOV_WASTE_AGRICULTURAL_SUBSIDIES)),
    ("Corporate Welfare", float(US_GOV_WASTE_CORPORATE_WELFARE)),
    ("Regulatory Red Tape", float(US_GOV_WASTE_REGULATORY_RED_TAPE)),
]

categories.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)

waste_arr = np.array([c[1] for c in categories])
total_waste = waste_arr.sum()
total_times = total_waste / proposed_funding

# Build markdown table
rows = []
rows.append("| Category | Annual Waste | x Treaty Funding |")
rows.append("|:---------|------------:|-----------------:|")
for name, w in categories:
    t = w / proposed_funding
    rows.append(f"| {name} | ${w/1e9:.0f}B | {t:.1f}x |")
rows.append(f"| **Total** | **${total_waste/1e12:.1f}T** | **{total_times:.0f}x** |")
rows.append("")
rows.append(
    f": The eradication program needs ${proposed_funding/1e9:.1f}B/yr for {proposed_clearance:.0f} years "
    f"(${total_program_cost/1e9:.0f}B total) to avert {proposed_dalys/1e9:.0f}B DALYs "
    f"({proposed_dalys/ceiling_dalys*100:.0f}% of the {ceiling_dalys/1e9:.0f}B ceiling). "
    f"Collectively, these waste categories exceed the needed funding by {total_times:.0f}x."
)

Markdown("\n".join(rows))
```
